app.about.affiliation.value: StremioNative is an independent, unofficial client. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Stremio, Smart Code OOD, LG Electronics or any addon operator. “Stremio” is used only to say what service the app works with.

app.about.content.value: The app ships no catalogs and no media. Everything it lists or plays comes from the addons you install, which decide what they serve. You are responsible for the addons you install.

app.about.licence.value: StremioNative is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later. You can get its complete source at:
app.about.licence.description: About: the licence statement; the source address follows on its own line.

app.about.plxnative_head.description: About: heading (shown in capitals) for the credit to the project it is derived from.

app.about.plxnative.value: StremioNative is derived from PlxNative, the native Plex client for LG televisions, and keeps its licence:
app.about.plxnative.description: About: the PlxNative credit; its address follows on its own line.

app.about.version_head.description: About: heading (shown in capitals) above the version string.

app.privacy.copy.value: What StremioNative sends, and to whom.
app.privacy.copy.description: Privacy page: the line under the title.

app.privacy.collects.value: StremioNative collects nothing. It has no analytics, no crash reporting and no usage telemetry, and it sends no data to its authors.

app.privacy.sign_in.value: Your Stremio email, password and session key go to api.strem.io, only to sign in and read your addons and library.
app.privacy.sign_in.description: Privacy: one line of what leaves the TV.

app.privacy.addons.value: Catalog, search, meta, stream and subtitle requests — including your search text and the item you open — go to the addons you installed. Subtitle requests also send the video's file name, size and hash, and subtitle files download from the hosts the addon names.
app.privacy.addons.description: Privacy: one line of what leaves the TV.

app.privacy.media.value: Media requests, with any headers an addon asked for, go to the hosts that serve the stream.
app.privacy.media.description: Privacy: one line of what leaves the TV.

app.privacy.artwork.value: Artwork requests go to the hosts in the addons’ image addresses.
app.privacy.artwork.description: Privacy: one line of what leaves the TV.

app.privacy.skip.value: Unless Skip intros is Off, the ID of the episode or film you play goes to api.introdb.app — for anime to api.aniskip.com, kitsu.io and arm.haglund.dev — to find its intro, recap and credits.
app.privacy.skip.description: Privacy: one line of what leaves the TV. Skip intros is the Settings row; the hosts are proper names.

app.privacy.stays.value: Your session key and settings are stored on the TV only and removed when you sign out. Logs stay on the TV, scrubbed of keys, passwords, addon configuration and search text.

app.privacy.full.description: Privacy: where the full statement is; the address is a URL.
